scope: County-intersecting source segments clipped to pilot boxes. Border segments may extend outside Fresno County.
limitations: Reference snapshot, not live flow or a complete ditch inventory. County/district additions and local names require review.
license: USGS public-domain federal reference data; Esri background attribution retained separately.

cartography.labelRule: One point anchor per normalized published name; four principal names snap to source paths near the dam areas, others use the midpoint of the longest clipped source path. Native collision avoidance may hide crowded names.
cartography.symbolRule: Canal: source types 2/3 or published name containing canal/ditch. River: type 1 or named type 5 containing river. Other network connectors dotted. Named waterbody centerlines remain references, not channel beds.
